pages.title: Survival and scouting
pages.text: $(li)$(item)Armor$(): any armor piece; usage 20. Adds four armor points while working.$(li)$(item)Nightvision$(): helmet; usage 20. See in the dark.$(li)$(item)Scramble$(): helmet; usage 50. Avoids Sentinel detection; does not pacify other enemies.$(li)$(item)Regeneration$(): chestplate; usage 40. Grants Regeneration III.$(li)$(item)Forcefield$(): chestplate; usage 80. See the recharge and retaliation pages.

pages.title: Movement
pages.text: $(li)$(item)Flight$(): chestplate; usage 30. Hold Jump for upward thrust; sneak to descend.$(li)$(item)Hover$(): chestplate; usage 10. Holds altitude while Flight is working.$(li)$(item)Speed$(): leggings; usage 20. Faster forward/backward movement on the ground and in flight, without changing FOV.$(li)$(item)Featherfalling$(): boots; usage 20. Prevents fall damage while working.$(li)$(item)Step Assist$(): boots; usage 10. Steps over obstacles almost two blocks tall.

pages.title: Plan your loadout
pages.text: Flight, Hover and Regeneration together use 80 on the chestplate. Adding Forcefield would exceed even an Energy-assisted budget; choose which abilities to run.$(br2)Each piece needs its own Energy module to raise its budget. All powered gear draws fuel from a carried $(l:ariente:equipment/fuel)Energy Holder$(/l).$(br2)Some modules come from equipment loot rather than blueprints. Invisibility is currently unavailable in the configuration panel.$(br2)Fuel exhaustion, disabling or removing a module stops its ability. Check fuel before a climb or fight.

pages.title: Forcefield recharge
pages.text: A ready field blocks projectiles and magic, including lasers, and absorbs 80% of explosions.$(br2)Each hit flashes red and starts a shared recharge timer: at least half a second, or about two seconds for a fully blocked advanced drone laser. Further hits reset it based on damage absorbed.$(br2)During recharge, protection drops to 50% for ranged/magic hits and 40% for explosions. The bubble stays faint in first person.

pages.title: Melee retaliation
pages.text: The field always halves melee damage and reflects half the incoming melee damage back as Thorns damage. The attacker's defenses can reduce it.$(br2)Projectiles, magic and explosions never trigger retaliation. Reflected Thorns cannot bounce between shields.$(br2)Other armor-bypassing damage, such as falling or drowning, is not blocked by the field.
